entry_state: Cash-settled awards remeasure their liability;equity awards retain grant-date cost subject to the relevant vesting conditions. Settlement chooser and actual cash obligation determine treatment. Beneficial modifications add incremental cost on its own service clock. Participation reallocates ordinary earnings when assumed shares change,including senior/capped rights. Restricted additive gross effects admit an ordered calculation;shared bonus/tax effects can be nonadditive. Complete conditional EPS worlds do not establish a valid dilution selector. The dependent-EPS subsection continues with contingent similar instruments after228.
exit_state: Contingent EPS requires current condition evidence and the assumed exercise of admitted similar outstanding instruments. Participating-dividend tax allocation can affect EPS without creating a tax asset,journal or dividend;its signed residual prevents attributing older benefits twice. Consolidation needs evidenced control,dated perimeters and separate elimination books. Acquisition,retained-control purchases,loss of control,intercompany tax and currency presentation have different effects. The foreign-subsidiary lifecycle begins at234;proportionate NCI leaves goodwill and its translation gain attributable to the parent. Its disposal continuation remains unread.

Group examples state distinct acquisition assumptions,retain legal books and separate functional-currency remeasurement from group translation. The integrated foreign-subsidiary example starts proving why goodwill translation is not mechanically split80/20;its enclosing section remains incomplete.
